finding.observed: After a complete close, an existing wrapper executed and committed a second business statement. The recorder rejected new events, but only recorded gaps in memory. Original sealed storage was unchanged. Both instance and fresh-reader exports still returned complete:true with an empty gap array and only the earlier statement.
finding.requiredBehavior: Preserve original business calls and sealed evidence bytes; reject the affected session instance permanently and persist a separate append-only invalidation marker checked by fresh readers/export/archive/reopen. If invalidation IO fails, the live instance must still refuse successful export.
finding.limits: Supported synchronous fake driver with real journal filesystem IO. This reproduces recorder closure integrity, not a PostgreSQL or application consistency result.

relatedExistingEvidence.scope: The actual database fixture passed 7/7. Six mapped model inputs were rejected for producer columns.type instead of typeCode; they are retained failures and not repaired by this review.

independentFollowup: Reproduce wrapper.execute after close with preserved returned rows and commit result identity; require instance/fresh-reader strict export, archive and reopen refusal without changes to original index/segments/SQLite.
Reproduce driver facade connect after close: original raw connection remains returned, but the contradicted source closure must not yield a new complete export.
Inject failures into all invalidation-file creation paths; require the live session to refuse export even when no durable marker can be written.
Test normal known-row plus separate/repeated EOF produces exactly one matched condition, while true zero-row EOF keeps source unavailable and inconclusive.
Compare actual committed AFTER effect ledger to surviving write facts; retain unused UPSERT BEFORE candidates without emitting writes.
Test successful COMMIT, real ROLLBACK command response, real commit-time server SQLSTATE, and lost acknowledgement followed by idle rollback as separate paths.

Tamper exact SQL/parameters/prefix/columns/OLD-NEW/predecessor/clock/catalog/source/ledger and require SQL proof refusal; zero-row negative conditions cannot be repaired by later SELECT or final ledger.
